architecture.condition: three-role one-hot plus deterministic layer coordinate 2*layer/47-1; expert identity forbidden
architecture.name: MCB-WE-S0-v0
architecture.output_space_dominance_gate: materialize all 32768 decoded eight-vectors after canonical FP16 serialization, discard the encoder, and use exact nearest output-space assignment on every held-out vector; no representational advantage over that decoded table may be claimed

claim_boundary: A kill rejects only this frozen six-expert stage-0 cell. A promotion is an ideal-Gaussian-residual feasibility result on two held-out experts from the already authenticated six-expert panel. It is not a finite residual codec, not a model-wide generalization result, not a fresh-validation result, and not target achievement.

execution.optimizer: manual CuPy Adam, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, epsilon=1e-8
execution.training_matrix_schedule: round-robin over the 12 fit matrices; seeded vector sampling
execution.whole_holdout_evaluation: materialize every decoded output-space codeword and perform exact nearest-codeword search for every vector in all six holdout matrices

gaussian_control.matching: each synthetic natural row is independently standardized and affinely mapped to the corresponding source row mean and RMS
gaussian_control.training_and_evaluation: same split, architecture, initialization seed, steps, batches, exact search, quantized side and rate ledger as source

oracle.definition: decoded-FP16 materialized output-space exact-nearest codebook followed by an ideal continuous Gaussian residual code using every residual bit
oracle.hard_kill: KILL if the best of the two predeclared source seeds has pooled s < 0.16096404744368115 (equivalently its favorable F is > 0.8)
oracle.promote: PROMOTE only if both source seeds have pooled s >= 0.18096404744368115, every held-out expert has F <= 0.8 in both seeds, and both matched advantages s_source-s_gaussian are > 0
oracle.scope: containing only for the declared finite first stage plus Gaussian-residual member; not a converse for arbitrary nonlinear residual codecs

panel.source_payload_resolution: each output_relpath is resolved beneath the authenticated lock parent blind_protocol_v2/unblinded, never beneath the experiment package
